ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Social Services Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the Minnesota social services fraud, including the amount of money lost and the individuals and organizations involved
questions: How much money was lost due to the fraud?
Who were the main individuals and organizations involved?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify the key players involved. This could lead to further investigations and potential prosecutions.
